recurring_tells.tell: Every paragraph opens with a one-clause thesis sentence that hooks onto the previous paragraph's conclusion ("Old habits return because the self fights back." → "Because the self can strike back, rushing ahead is dangerous."). Read in sequence the openers form an outline.
recurring_tells.fix: In every second or third paragraph start with the particular (a quote, the anecdote, the verse) and let the point emerge by the second sentence; delete at least one 'therefore'/'because' hinge per page.

recurring_tells.tell: Paragraph-ending epigrams: "The journey therefore covers no distance.", "Most of us see only the lamp.", "The light had come to stay.", "A definition draws a line round its object, and there is no line to draw round God."
recurring_tells.fix: Cut the last sentence of the paragraph, or replace it with a concrete detail or the next fact; the point should already be clear from the body.

recurring_tells.tell: Mirror-image parallel frames used for paired items: "The first door is the tongue, and silence shuts it" / "The second door is the stomach, and hunger shuts it"; "Dark veils are the ones we make ourselves" / "Veils of light are finer, and we do not make them"; "The X meant here is not Y. It means Z" twice.
recurring_tells.fix: Keep the parallel for the first item only; introduce the second with a different construction, different length, or by contrast with the first rather than by repetition of the template.

recurring_tells.tell: Uniform sentence rhythm: runs of 8–14-word declaratives with almost no subordinate clauses or asides ("It does not leave the body completely. If it did, we would be dead. This explains how...").
recurring_tells.fix: Merge two or three short sentences into one with a subordinate clause or parenthesis, and allow one noticeably long sentence per paragraph.

recurring_tells.tell: Negation-then-correction ("It isn't a performance bug. It's a decision", "'Liars' does not mean the feats are faked... The lie is in", "not a lifelong vow... It means").
recurring_tells.fix: State the positive claim directly and drop the straw negative unless a real reader would hold it.

recurring_tells.tell: Explicit roadmap signposting ("Taking them one at a time shows...", "so the aim here is only to see the whole road in order", "This is the whole subject in one sentence", "the next question is").
recurring_tells.fix: Delete the signpost sentence; let headings and the first concrete item carry the structure.

recurring_tells.tell: Announced triads then walked through ("at three times: in sleep, at death, and in watchfulness"; "to see God with the heart, to love Him, and to be near Him"; "hear, see, and reflect").
recurring_tells.fix: Where the source gives three, keep the three but do not pre-announce the count; where the prose added the third for balance, drop it.

recurring_tells.tell: Abstract compression ("lived truth", "the knowing keeps growing", "gifts that stay are not arrival", "in its role as a welcoming guide").
recurring_tells.fix: Replace the abstract noun with the thing or act it stands for (what is said, done, or seen).
